q: To whom did the elder write 3 John?
why: He loved him in the truth.
quote: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth

q: In 3 John, what is the elder's greatest joy?
quote: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

q: In 3 John, the elder says do not imitate evil, but imitate what?
why: The one who does good is of God.
quote: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good.

q: In 3 John, what does the elder pray Gaius will enjoy?
quote: I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.

q: In 3 John, who loved to be first and would not accept the elder?
quote: but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.

q: In 3 John, who received a good testimony from everyone?
why: Even the truth spoke for him.
quote: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself.
